findings.required_change: Implement bounded server-side rate limiting for login, callback, confirmation, and authentication failures, and emit bounded sanitized audit events for the required authentication, authorization, confirmation, logout, expiry, revocation, and dependency-failure outcomes. Add focused positive and adversarial tests.
findings.summary: The HTTP and OIDC adapters contain neither rate limiting nor the required security audit emission.

findings.required_change: Restrict post-logout redirects to an explicit exact allowlist of approved local paths or same-origin destinations, reject external destinations during configuration, and test rejection of open-redirect configurations.
findings.summary: ProductOwnerOIDCConfig accepts any syntactically valid HTTPS post-logout URL, and logout redirects to it directly without enforcing the required local allowlist.

findings.required_change: Add executable tests covering the specified successful login, confirmation-service recording, logout, expiry, restart, consumption-time introspection, token-validation attacks, callback replay and PKCE mismatch, authority revocation and dependency outages, HTTP attack cases, concurrency, and stale-context behavior.
findings.summary: The submitted tests exercise URL construction, configuration checks, basic parsing, headers, and session rotation only; they do not prove the required end-to-end or adversarial security behavior.
